title: Circular Motion of a Charge in a Magnetic Field
theory: Uniform $B \perp v$ bends the path into a circle: $qvB = \dfrac{mv^2}{r}$ ⇒ $r = \dfrac{mv}{qB}$, with period $T = \dfrac{2\pi m}{qB}$ — **independent of speed** (the cyclotron principle). The charge's sign is read from the *first bend* via $\vec F = q\vec v\times\vec B$.
framework: Parameter changes are **ratios** — never recompute from scratch.

parts.title: Sign of the charge
parts.parameters:
- Given: $B$ out of the page fills the region $x > 0$; a particle of mass $m$, charge magnitude $q$, enters at the origin O along $+x$ with speed $v$; its path is a semicircle ending at point P on the $-y$ axis.
- Find: charge sign; force magnitude; radius; time O→P; the new radius if $B \to 2B$ and $v \to 3v$.
parts.formulas: first bend is toward $-y$; with $\vec v = v\hat x$, $\vec B = B\hat z$: $\hat x\times\hat z = -\hat y$.

parts.title: Radius
parts.parameters:
- Given: $B$ out of the page fills the region $x > 0$; a particle of mass $m$, charge magnitude $q$, enters at the origin O along $+x$ with speed $v$; its path is a semicircle ending at point P on the $-y$ axis.

parts.conclusion: geometry check: P sits one diameter below O, at $(0, -2r)$.

parts.title: Time from O to P
parts.parameters:
- Given: $B$ out of the page fills the region $x > 0$; a particle of mass $m$, charge magnitude $q$, enters at the origin O along $+x$ with speed $v$; its path is a semicircle ending at point P on the $-y$ axis.
- Find: charge sign; force magnitude; radius; time O→P; the new radius if $B \to 2B$ and $v \to 3v$.
parts.formulas: a semicircle is half a period.
parts.conclusion: independent of $v$ — doubling the speed doubles the radius, not the lap time.
